title: A value whose significand the IBM format cannot carry is refused
description: The binary32 nearest 0.1 is 0xCCCCCD × 2^-27, twenty-four significant bits. Its IBM fraction would stand at exponent 0x40, where one unit is 2^-24: the three low bits fall off, the nearest IBM number is another value, and it would read back as that value. A validation error.
